profile.headline: Senior Associate Software Engineer at Long Wave Inc.
profile.summary:
I am a software developer with about three years of experience in web development. I've worked with PHP, JavaScript, and React to build everything from simple websites to dynamic web apps, and I am always excited about building software. I am also always eager to learn new things, whether that's a new system, a new language, or a new skill completely different.

Lately, I've been diving into iOS and mobile app development and learning Swift. It's been something I have wanted to try out for a while and is something I've found a lot of enjoyment in.

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: C# · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · Python · XAML

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
Implemented multi-national support for many new countries for our premier payroll product using PHP for the backend and React, Javascript, HTML, and CSS for the front end, and mySQL to work for our databases
Enhanced check approval functionality by creating a new system that allowed users to split check approvals by groups with varying criteria for each group; developed a feature to allow clients to create and edit custom email notification templates
Deployed the above features went out to 10,000+ clients
Assisted team members with their development work when they ran into issues or needed help
Collaborated with various teams across different products and business units to integrate technology effectively
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · JavaScript · HTML5 · React.js · Back-End Web Development · SQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Cognixia’s JUMP program is a hyper-intense technical training program that gives top STEM talent from across the U.S. the equivalent of 12-18 months of industry experience. Not only do they up-skill their technical abilities, they also evolve their digital mindset to successfully adapt and utilize technology in an efficient manner so they can JUMP start their careers via deployment with Collabera clients.

– Unix/Linux Proficiency - familiar with file navigation and manipulation in Unix based environments
– Version control - Utilized git to collaborate
with team members and maintain uniformity
in code amongst members
– Networking and Security – Used Linux and Git CLI to administrate servers and implement firewalls

projects.title: Github Finder
projects.description: A web app to search and display github profiles. Built in React

projects.title: Notes
projects.description: An iOS note taking app modeled after the default iOS notes app. The app uses a table view to display a list of all notes, and uses core data so that the notes will be saved even if the user closes the app

organizations.name: Computer Science Society
organizations.description: As the Secretary for the Computer Science Society, I regulary inform the Computer Science department of our events, such as Hack Hofstra, a twelve hour hackathon, and our various workshops we do throughout the semester.

organizations.name: Hofstra Rock Climbing Club
organizations.description: As the Treasurer for the rock climbing club at Hofstra University, I manage the club's budget ensuring that the club has funds for all of its trips throughout the semester.
